tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.description: Get a link where the person can upload a photo from their phone or computer. Use this when the person has a photo on their device but you have no public URL for it. After the upload, the page shows a photo code (ph_...). Pass that code as photo_id to create_cross_stitch_pattern.

tools.name: create_cross_stitch_pattern
tools.description: Turn a photo into a cross stitch pattern preview with real DMC thread colours. Returns a preview image of the stitched result, the thread list (DMC numbers and stitch counts), the stitch count and the finished size. Give exactly one of image_url, photo_id or image_base64. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_photo_upload_link, create_cross_stitch_pattern, get_kit_prices · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_photo_upload_link, create_cross_stitch_pattern, get_kit_prices · Public sink: get_photo_upload_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
